name: @tuucho/plugin-tuucho-signin-facebook
description: Facebook Login into the kernel sign-in shell. App id, OAuth return URL, and app secret live here.

appId.label: Facebook app id
appId.description: Numeric App ID from Meta for Developers. Required before Facebook Login appears on the shop.
appId.sectionDescription: Credentials from the Meta app. The kernel sign-in shell stays on Preferences; fill these to actually connect.

appSecret.label: Facebook app secret
appSecret.description: App secret from Meta. Never shown after save. Type a new value only to replace it.

oauthReturnUrl.label: OAuth return URL
oauthReturnUrl.description: Must match a Valid OAuth Redirect URI in the Meta app (this shop’s /auth/facebook-return). Wrong host = Facebook error.
oauthReturnUrl.sectionDescription: Where Facebook sends the browser after login, and how long a first-time signup token lives.

signupTokenTtl.label: Signup token TTL
signupTokenTtl.description: How long a first-time Facebook signup token stays valid (for example 10m). Raise only if customers need longer to finish.
